name: payer-ops-structured-determination
description: Produce the exact structured JSON deliverable for a Northstar-style payer-operations task by reading a shared read-only case environment. Use this when a task hands you a target business ID (a case, appeal, claim, peer-to-peer event, or finance queue), a read-only operations environment (a SQL query endpoint plus business GET endpoints), and a JSON answer template to fill. Covers prior-authorization / UM nurse determinations, coverage-exception appeals with manufacturer-assistance intake, claim repricing against rate benchmarks, peer-to-peer closures, and margin-queue analysis.
